trackers.product_line: Firebase Crashlytics, the crash reporter Google runs for app developers
data_collected: stack traces and the app's state when it crashes
device details at the moment of a crash: model, operating system version, RAM and disk space, whether it is rooted
custom keys, logs and a user ID, if the app's developer adds them
trackers.monetization_model: A free crash reporter for app developers. Google processes the reports on the developer's behalf, as its processor or service provider (Firebase's privacy page and data processing terms).

data_flows.purpose: Crash reports for the app's developer: what the app was doing when it crashed, and details of the device. Google processes them for the developer and keeps them for 90 days
data_flows.wording: According to Google's Firebase documentation (updated 2026-10-08) and the Firebase Data Processing and Security Terms (2024-08-21).
